verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents an official, hosted MCP server (sandbox and production endpoints, OAuth via Dashboard account) with concrete setup instructions (e.g., adding it to Claude Code) and documented capabilities like querying payments, issuing refunds, managing payment links, and knowledge-base search — directly fulfilling the story. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of real-world usage beyond vendor docs, and it's explicitly marked Beta.
